Name: How to make a Roommate - NPC Template
Author: M3g4Pint
Description:
[center][color=#00ffff][size=5][b]How to Make a Roommate![/b][/size][/color][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I was struggling to create a Krobus style platonic roommate, until now. So I thought I'd add this very minimally fleshed out NPC, with simple commented code, to help others if they have the inkling to do so.[/size][/color]

[center]Our test subject "Chet" will be waiting at the bus stop, talk to him for hearts and the roommate gift. Then you just need the first house upgrade and you can move him in.[/center]

[u][b][size=4]Brass Tacks[/size][/b][/u]
To make a roommate you need to create a gift-able object with a certain context tag, include certain dialog, and have a couple of maps so you don't end up with Abigail's default spaces. Please take special note of naming and case sensitivity.

This is in no way an exhaustive list of things you can do with a roommate, but just enough to get you started.

For modders who already have the basics of NPC creation / Map creation. Or are willing to grind out some tutorials.

Base game assets used for reference.
[center][/center]
[center][color=#00ffff][b][If anyone wants to add to this or be generally helpful then please leave a comment][/b][/color][/center]
